moworks.notes: Idea and numbers (TakayuStudio t-stagger-center, written here): 8 × 4 grid of 24 px tiles (32 px pitch): each tile starts at its distance from the grid centre × 40 ms (recipe; site demo × 70 ms per cell), 400 ms power2.out each (demo: spring k 260, c 20). Rule: ripples for hero entrances and spreading reactions. Params: each (40 ms mỗi đơn vị khoảng cách) · duration (0.4 s) · from (center). A ripple from the middle: for hero entrances and spreading reactions.
